source.name: Orlando City SC – 'Orlando City SC unveils 2026 Sunken Treasure kit presented by Orlando Health'
source.quote: Orlando City SC today unveiled the Sunken Treasure Kit, presented by Orlando Health, the Club’s new community kit through the 2027-28 Major League Soccer season.

source.name: FOR SOCCER – '2026 MLS Jersey Sponsors'
source.quote: media partner Apple, once again, will be on the left sleeve of every jersey
source.note: The same page's sleeve table lists Orlando City SC with Apple TV on the left sleeve and no right-sleeve partner; its front-of-jersey table lists Orlando Health for Orlando City SC.

summary: Gold adidas Sunken Treasure kit, presented by Orlando Health on the front through the 2027-28 season. Apple TV sits on the left sleeve of every MLS kit; Orlando City has no right-sleeve partner for 2026.
